outlook.title: Northeastern Atlantic
outlook.summary: A strong non-tropical area of low pressure is located over the northeastern Atlantic several hundred miles northeast of the Azores. This system could acquire some subtropical or tropical characteristics on Saturday or early Sunday while it moves east-southeastward at 10 to 15 mph toward Portugal and northwestern Spain.
